name: codex-pi-coordination
description: Coordinate bounded implementation, research, review and validation tasks between Codex and Pi inside NVIDIA OpenShell.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate scoped work to Pi and verify its return.
interface.longDescription: Codex owns task scope and acceptance. Pi works in a disposable OpenShell workspace and returns bounded artifacts, while a stdlib runner records actual command results and managed cleanup.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-pi-coordination to delegate a bounded task to Pi and verify the returned work.
